hero.title: {mangaTitle} Manga
hero.description: Jack of all trades party of none is a Japanese manga series written by Itsuki Togami and illustrated by Yonezou. Originally a web novel on Shōsetsuka ni Narō since February 2021, the manga adaptation began serialization in Kodansha's Suiyōbi no Sirius in October 2021, with 17 volumes released as of December 2025. Orun Dula, a versatile adventurer who switched from swordsman to enchanter for his party's needs, is suddenly expelled by the Hero Party for being a "jack of all trades, master of none." Branded as useless despite his adaptability, Orun returns to solo adventuring as a swordsman. However, his time mastering multiple skills wasn't wasted—his unique ability to quickly learn and combine various abilities transforms him into an unconventional powerhouse. What his former party saw as weakness becomes his greatest strength as he embarks on a journey to prove that being a jack of all trades can lead to becoming a master of all.
